title: Spread The Sculk
description: New enchantment that spread the sculk when you kill a mob.
body:
This mod introduces a brand new, rare enchantment called Spread the Sculk. When applied to any sword or axe, this enchantment changes the way you fight and farm experience.

When you kill a mob while holding an enchanted weapon, Sculk blocks will instantly spread from the death point, covering the ground and nearby surfaces.

Additionally, each kill grants you significantly more XP than usual — as if the Sculk itself is rewarding you for feeding it.
